en.s: The Battle of Mutina took place on 21 April 43 BC between the forces loyal to the Senate under consuls Gaius Vibius Pansa and Aulus Hirtius, supported by the forces of Caesar Octavian, versus the forces of Mark Antony which were besieging the troops of Decimus Brutus. The latter, one of Caesar's assassins, held the city of Mutina (present-day Modena) in Cisalpine Gaul.

zh.s: 公元前43年4月21日，支持元老院的军队与围攻德基穆斯·布鲁图所部的马克·安东尼军队在穆蒂纳交战。元老院方面由执政官盖乌斯·维比乌斯·潘萨和奥卢斯·赫尔提乌斯指挥，并得到凯撒·屋大维军队支持。德基穆斯·布鲁图是刺杀凯撒的参与者之一，当时守卫山南高卢的穆蒂纳城（今摩德纳）。

en.t: A debt was pardoned by the chief of Tondo on the island of Luzon and recorded on the Laguna Copperplate Inscription, the earliest known calendar-dated document found in the Philippines
en.s: The Laguna Copperplate Inscription is an official acquittance (debt relief) certificate inscribed onto a copper plate in the Shaka year 822 (Gregorian A.D. 900). It is the earliest-known, extant, calendar-dated document found within the Philippines. The plate was found in 1987 by a laborer near the mouth of the Lumbang River in Wawa, Lumban, Laguna, in the Philippines.

zh.t: 拉古纳铜版铭文记载汤都首领赦免债务
zh.s: 拉古纳铜版铭文是一份刻在铜板上的正式债务免除证明，记载于萨迦历822年（公元900年），是目前在菲律宾境内发现的最早一份有明确历日的文献。1987年，一名工人在菲律宾拉古纳省卢班镇瓦瓦村附近的卢邦河河口发现了这块铜板。

en.s: The Battle of Seminara of 1503 took place on 21 April 1503, near Seminara and Gioia Tauro, Calabria, between the French troops under the command of Bérault Stuart d'Aubigny and the Spanish troops commanded by Don Fernando de Andrade during the Second Italian War.

en.s: On 19 April 1506, a crowd of churchgoers in Lisbon attacked and killed several people in the congregation whom they suspected were Jews. The violence escalated into a city-wide, antisemitic riot that killed between 500 and 4,000 "New Christians" (Cristãos-Novos), the name for Jews who had been forcibly converted to Christianity.

en.s: The First Battle of Panipat, on 21 April 1526, was fought between the invading forces of Babur and the Ibrahim Lodi. It took place in north India and marked the beginning of the Mughal Empire. This was one of the earliest battles involving gunpowder firearms and field artillery in India.

zh.s: 第一次帕尼帕特战役于1526年4月21日爆发，交战双方是巴布尔率领的入侵军和易卜拉欣·洛迪的军队。战场位于印度北部，此战标志着莫卧儿帝国的开端。这也是印度较早使用火药武器和野战炮兵的战役之一。

en.t: The Wignacourt Aqueduct is inaugurated in Malta
en.s: The Wignacourt Aqueduct (Maltese: L-Akwedott ta' Wignacourt) is a 17th-century aqueduct in Malta, which was built by the Order of Saint John to carry water from springs in Dingli and Rabat to the newly built capital city Valletta. The aqueduct carried water through underground pipes and over arched viaducts across depressions in the ground.

zh.t: 马耳他维尼亚库尔输水渠开通
zh.s: 1615年4月21日，马耳他的维尼亚库尔输水渠开通。这座17世纪的输水设施由圣约翰骑士团修建，将丁利和拉巴特的泉水引向新建的首都瓦莱塔；水流经地下管道，也通过跨越低洼地带的拱形高架渠。

en.s: The Azov campaigns of 1637 and 1641, in Russian historiography known as Azov sitting (Russian: Азовское сидение, romanized: Azovskoe sidenie), were a series of conflicts over the control of Azov fortress between Don–Zaporozhian Cossacks and Ottoman–Crimean forces from 21 April 1637 to 30 April 1642.

zh.s: 1637年和1641年的阿速海战役在俄罗斯史学中称为“阿速海围守战”（俄语：Азовское сидение），是顿河—扎波罗热哥萨克人与奥斯曼—克里米亚军队为争夺阿速海要塞而发生的一系列冲突，时间为1637年4月21日至1642年4月30日。

en.s: The siege of Lichfield occurred on 8–21 April 1643 during the First English Civil War. During the military action, the Royalists under the command of Prince Rupert successfully besieged the Parliamentary garrison of Lichfield in Staffordshire under the command of Colonel Russell.

en.s: The Sudbury Fight (April 21, 1676) was a battle of King Philip's War, fought in what is today Sudbury and Wayland, Massachusetts, when approximately five hundred Wampanoag, Nipmuc, and Narragansett Native Americans raided the frontier settlement of Sudbury in Massachusetts Bay Colony. Disparate companies of English militiamen from nearby settlements marched to the town's defense, two of which were drawn into Native ambushes and suffered heavy losses.

zh.s: 萨德伯里之战发生于1676年4月21日，是菲利普王战争中的一场战斗，地点在今天马萨诸塞州萨德伯里和韦兰一带。当时约500名万帕诺亚格人、尼普穆克人和纳拉甘西特人袭击了马萨诸塞湾殖民地边境聚居点萨德伯里。附近聚居点的数支英国民兵部队赶来防守，其中两支遭到伏击并损失惨重。

en.s: The Battle of Pułtusk took place on April 21, 1703 in Pułtusk during the Great Northern War. The Swedish army under the command of Charles XII defeated the Saxon army under Adam Heinrich von Steinau. Charles goes on to take Thorn in December.

zh.s: 大北方战争期间，瑞典军队与亚当·海因里希·冯·施泰瑙率领的萨克森军队于1703年4月21日在普乌图斯克交战。查理十二世率领的瑞典军队获胜。查理随后于同年12月攻占托伦。

en.s: The Battle of Biskupice (Hungarian: Püspöki csata, German: Schlacht bei Bischdorf, Slovak: Bitka pri Biskupiciach) was a battle between the Kurucs (Hungarians) and the Danish auxiliaries of the Habsburg army in April 21, 1704. The Austrian commander Hannibal Heister in March 1704 merged with the troops (Germans, Danes, Serbs) near Komarno. The Austrian plane was the cleaning of the Great Rye Island up the Kurucs. This region he joined Rákóczi in 1703. The Kuruc forces threatened Pressburg and also Komarno. In Pressburg being general Johann von Ritschan, but in spring was ordered back to Moravia.

zh.s: 比斯库皮采战役（匈牙利语：Püspöki csata；德语：Schlacht bei Bischdorf；斯洛伐克语：Bitka pri Biskupiciach）是1704年4月21日库鲁茨军队（匈牙利人）与哈布斯堡军队中的丹麦辅助部队之间的一场战斗。1704年3月，奥地利指挥官汉尼拔·海斯特在科马尔诺附近会合了德意志、丹麦和塞尔维亚部队。奥方计划扫荡大玉米岛上的库鲁茨势力。拉科齐于1703年在当地发动起义，库鲁茨部队威胁到普雷斯堡和科马尔诺。普雷斯堡由约翰·冯·里奇安将军驻守，但他在春季接到命令，返回摩拉维亚。

en.s: The Hotak revolt was a major uprising by the Afghan Hotak tribe against Safavid Persian rule in 1709, led by Mirwais Hotak. The rebellion was triggered by the oppressive and provocative behavior of the Georgian commander Gurgin Khan and his troops, who governed Kandahar on behalf of the Safavid Empire. Gurgin Khan's administration imposed heavy taxes on the local Sunni Afghan population and seized goods, women, and children.

zh.s: 1709年，阿富汗霍塔克部族在米尔维斯·霍塔克领导下，反抗萨法维波斯统治。格鲁吉亚指挥官古尔金汗及其部队代表萨法维帝国治理坎大哈，其压迫性做法引发了起义。古尔金汗当局向当地逊尼派阿富汗人征收重税，还掠走财物、妇女和儿童。

en.s: The Battle of Reichenberg was a battle of the Seven Years' War, fought on April 21, 1757 near the town of Reichenberg (Czech: Liberec) in Bohemia. Marshal von Bevern had entered Bohemia with a corps of 16,000 Prussians. At Reichenberg he encountered Königsegg's Austrian corps. The full Austrian corps consisted of 18,000 infantry and 4,900 cavalry, but only about 10,000 of them had been concentrated at Reichenberg. The experienced Bevern defeated his opponent. As a result, Bevern captured large quantities of Austrian supplies and could continue his march on Prague.

zh.s: 赖兴贝格战役是七年战争中的一场战斗，于1757年4月21日在波希米亚赖兴贝格镇（今捷克利贝雷茨）附近爆发。贝韦恩元帅率领1.6万名普鲁士士兵进入波希米亚，在赖兴贝格遇到柯尼希塞格率领的奥军。奥军全军有1.8万名步兵和4900名骑兵，但当时只有约1万人集结在赖兴贝格。经验丰富的贝韦恩击败对手，缴获大量奥军物资，得以继续向布拉格进军。

en.s: The Gunpowder Incident (or Powder Alarm or Gunpowder Affair) was a conflict early in the American Revolutionary War between Lord Dunmore, the Royal Governor of the Colony of Virginia, and militia led by Patrick Henry. On April 21, 1775, two days after the Battles of Lexington and Concord (and well before news of those events reached Virginia), Lord Dunmore ordered the removal of the gunpowder from the magazine in Williamsburg, Virginia, to a Royal Navy ship.

zh.s: 火药事件又称火药警报或火药风波，是美国独立战争初期弗吉尼亚殖民地总督邓莫尔勋爵与帕特里克·亨利领导的民兵之间的一场冲突。1775年4月21日，也就是列克星敦和康科德战役两天后、消息尚未传到弗吉尼亚时，邓莫尔下令将威廉斯堡军火库中的火药运上英国皇家海军舰船。

en.s: The Battle of Ushant (also known as the action of 20–21 April 1782 or the Third Battle of Ushant) was fought on 20–21 April 1782 during the American Revolutionary War between a French Navy squadron of three ships of the line protecting a convoy of 12 transport ships and a Royal Navy fleet off Ushant, a French island at the mouth of the English Channel off the northwesternmost point of France.

en.t: The city of Rattanakosin, now known internationally as Bangkok, is founded on the eastern bank of the Chao Phraya River by King Buddha Yodfa Chulaloke
en.s: Bangkok, known in Thai as Krung Thep Maha Nakhon and colloquially as Krung Thep, is the capital and largest city of Thailand. The city occupies 1,568.7 square kilometres (605.7 sq mi) in the Chao Phraya River delta in central Thailand and has an estimated population of 9.1 million people as of 2024, 15.9% of the country's population.

zh.t: 曼谷新都的城市柱竖立
zh.s: 1782年4月21日，拉玛一世迁都湄南河东岸后竖立曼谷的城市柱，这一天被视为曼谷作为首都的建城日。曼谷在泰语中称“恭贴玛哈那空”，口语简称“恭贴”，是泰国首都和最大城市，位于中部湄南河三角洲。原文所引2024年估计人口为910万，约占全国人口的15.9%，市域面积约1,568.7平方公里。

en.t: George Washington's reception at Trenton is hosted by the Ladies of Trenton as he journeys to New York City for his first inauguration
en.s: George Washington's reception at Trenton was a celebration hosted by the Ladies of Trenton social club on April 21, 1789, in Trenton, New Jersey, as George Washington, then president-elect, journeyed from his home at Mount Vernon to his first inauguration in the then capital of the United States, New York City.

en.s: The Battle of Mondovì was fought on 21 April 1796 between the French army of Napoleon Bonaparte and the army of the Kingdom of Sardinia-Piedmont led by Michelangelo Alessandro Colli-Marchi. The French victory meant that they had put the Ligurian Alps behind them, while the plains of Piedmont lay before them. A week later, King Victor Amadeus III sued for peace, taking his kingdom out of the First Coalition. The defeat of their Sardinian ally wrecked Austrian Habsburg strategy and led to the loss of northwest Italy to the First French Republic.

zh.s: 1796年4月21日，拿破仑·波拿巴率领的法军与米开朗基罗·亚历山德罗·科利-马尔基指挥的撒丁-皮埃蒙特王国军队在蒙多维交战。法军获胜后越过利古里亚阿尔卑斯山，皮埃蒙特平原就在眼前。一周后，维托里奥·阿梅迪奥三世国王求和，使其王国退出第一次反法同盟。盟友撒丁王国战败，打乱了奥地利哈布斯堡王朝的战略，西北意大利最终落入法兰西第一共和国之手。

The first engagement saw an overwhelming British Royal Navy force consisting of two ships of the line attack and destroy a French Navy frigate in Moustique Inlet near the town of Jean-Rabel on the Northern coast of the French colony of Saint-Domingue (which later gained independence as Haiti).

en.t: Battle of the Raz de Sein
en.s: The Battle of the Raz de Sein was a single-ship naval engagement of the blockade of Brest during the French Revolutionary Wars between a French and Royal Navy ships of the line on 21 April 1798. The British blockade fleet under Admiral Lord Bridport had sailed from St Helens on 12 April and on the morning of 21 April was crossing the Iroise Passage when sails were spotted to the east.

en.s: The capture of Brescia took place on 21 April 1799, during the Second Coalition war: General Field Marshal Count A. V. Suvorov's Russian and Habsburg troops took the fortress city of Brescia, having captivated the French garrison of General Bouzet. Alexander Suvorov-Rymniksky, realising the importance of the impression of his first encounter with the French, sent here the vanguard of Kray and the division of Zopf, a total of 15,000 men assembled, and ordered Vukassovich to descend from the mountains also to Brescia; in all, more than 20,000 men.

zh.s: 第二次反法同盟战争期间，亚历山大·苏沃洛夫元帅指挥的俄哈联军于1799年4月21日攻占布雷西亚要塞城，俘获布泽将军指挥的法军守军。苏沃洛夫深知首次与法国军队交锋的重要性，派克赖和佐普夫师的先头部队共1.5万人前往，并命令武卡索维奇也从山地向布雷西亚进军。最终投入兵力超过2万人。

en.s: The 1802 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was an election held on April 21, 1802, to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Arthur Fenner, the incumbent governor and Democratic-Republican candidate, beat the Federalist candidate William Greene with 66.28% of the vote.

zh.s: 罗得岛州于1802年4月21日举行州长选举。时任州长、民主共和党候选人阿瑟·芬纳以66.28%的得票率击败联邦党候选人威廉·格林。

en.s: The Action of 21 April 1806 was a minor engagement between a French frigate and British forces off South Africa during the Napoleonic Wars. The Île Bonaparte and Île de France constituted French outposts in the Indian Ocean, from which privateers and frigate squadrons could engage in commerce raiding and disrupt British shipping. After encountering a strongly escorted British convoy, the 40-gun Cannonière attempted to flee, but was rejoined by the 74-gun HMS Tremendous]. In the ensuing battle, Captain Bourayne displayed superior sailmanship and managed to fend off his much strong opponent by a combination of manoeuvers that rendered the batteries of Tremendous ineffective, and threatened her of sustaining raking fire.

zh.s: 拿破仑战争期间，1806年4月21日，法国护卫舰与英国军队在南非近海发生小规模交战。留尼汪岛和法兰西岛是法国在印度洋的前哨基地，私掠船和护卫舰分舰队可从那里袭击商船、扰乱英国航运。“加农尼埃尔号”40炮护卫舰遇到护航严密的英国船队后试图逃离，但被英国74炮战舰“宏伟号”追上。随后交战中，布雷纳船长凭借高超的操船技术，通过机动使“宏伟号”的炮台难以发挥作用，并威胁要遭受纵向炮火袭击，成功抵挡住强敌。

en.s: The Battle of Eckmühl fought on 21–22 April 1809, was the turning point of the 1809 Campaign, also known as the War of the Fifth Coalition. Napoleon I had been unprepared for the start of hostilities on 10 April 1809, by the Austrians under Archduke Charles of Austria, and for the first time since assuming the French Imperial Crown had been forced to give up the strategic initiative to an opponent. Thanks to the dogged defense waged by the III Corps, commanded by Marshal Davout, and the Bavarian VII Corps, commanded by Marshal Lefebvre, Napoleon was able to defeat the principal Austrian army and wrest the strategic initiative for the remainder of the war.

zh.s: 埃克米尔战役于1809年4月21日至22日进行，是1809年战役（又称第五次反法同盟战争）的转折点。1809年4月10日，奥地利大公查理率军开战，拿破仑一世起初措手不及，自加冕为法国皇帝以来首次被对手夺去战略主动权。达武元帅指挥的第3军和勒费弗尔元帅指挥的巴伐利亚第7军顽强防守，帮助拿破仑击败奥军主力，并在战争余下阶段重新掌握战略主动。

en.s: The Battle of Ronco was a battle in the Neapolitan War the took place on 21 April 1815 in the village of Ronco, just south of Forlì. The main Neapolitan army, retreating following the disaster at the Battle of Occhiobello, was being pursued by an Austrian corps under the command of Adam Albert von Neipperg. The Neapolitans, commanded by their king, Joachim Murat, turned to check the Austrians at the Ronco River. The Neapolitans rear guard was defeated by a smaller advanced Austrian force, compelling Murat to retreat further south to the Savio River.

en.s: The Battle of San Jacinto, fought on April 21, 1836, in present-day Harris County, Texas, was the decisive battle of the Texas Revolution. Led by General Sam Houston, the Texian Army engaged and defeated General Antonio López de Santa Anna's Mexican army in a fight that lasted just 18 minutes. Santa Anna, the President of Mexico, was captured and surrendered the following day and held as a prisoner of war. Three weeks later, he signed the peace treaty that dictated that the Mexican army leave the region, paving the way for the Republic of Texas to become an independent country.

en.s: The Louisiana gubernatorial election of 1896 was held on April 21, 1896. Like most Southern states between Reconstruction and the civil rights era, Louisiana's Republican Party was virtually nonexistent in terms of electoral support. As Louisiana had not yet adopted party primaries, this meant that the Democratic Party convention nomination vote was supposed to be the real contest over who would be governor. However, the Republicans and Populists put forward a joint candidate, John N. Pharr. With combined Republican and Populist support Pharr garnered 43% of the vote, although the Democratic nominee, Murphy J. Foster was elected with 57% of the vote.

en.s: The 1929–30 season First Division match between Leicester City and Arsenal at Filbert Street took place on 21 April 1930. The game finished as a 6–6 draw, the highest scoring draw in the history of first class English football. The record still stands today, though was matched in a Second Division fixture between Charlton Athletic and Middlesbrough in October 1960.

zh.t: 莱斯特城6比6战平阿森纳（1930年）
zh.s: 1929—30赛季英格兰甲级联赛中，莱斯特城与阿森纳的比赛于1930年4月21日在菲尔伯特街球场举行，最终双方6比6战平。这是英格兰顶级足球联赛历史上进球最多的平局纪录，至今仍未被打破；1960年10月，查尔顿竞技与米德尔斯堡在英格兰乙级联赛中也曾踢成6比6。

en.t: The "Surgeon's Photograph", the most famous photo allegedly showing the Loch Ness Monster, is published in the Daily Mail (in 1994, it is revealed to be a hoax)
en.s: The Loch Ness Monster (Scottish Gaelic: Uilebheist Loch Nis), known affectionately as Nessie, is a mythical creature in Scottish folklore that is said to inhabit Loch Ness in the Scottish Highlands. It is often described as large, long-necked, and with one or more humps protruding from the water. Popular interest and belief in the creature has varied since it was brought to worldwide attention in 1933.

zh.t: “外科医生照片”登上《每日邮报》
zh.s: 1934年4月21日，英国《每日邮报》刊出一张据称拍到尼斯湖水怪的照片；这张后来被证实造假的“外科医生照片”广为流传。尼斯湖水怪又昵称“妮西”，是苏格兰传说中栖息在高地尼斯湖的神秘生物，常被描绘为身躯庞大、脖颈修长，水面露出一个或多个驼峰。自1933年引起国际关注以来，公众对其兴趣与信奉程度时有起伏。

en.s: The 1935 Shinchiku-Taichū earthquake occurred with a Richter magnitude of 7.1 (7.1 Mw) in April 1935 with its epicenter in Miaoli, Taiwan (then part of Shinchiku Prefecture). It was the deadliest earthquake in Taiwan's recorded history, claiming 3,276 lives and causing extensive damage. Twelve seconds after the mainshock, an aftershock of ML 6.0 occurred, centered on Gabi Village (present-day Emei Township, Hsinchu County).

zh.s: 1935年4月，台湾发生新竹—台中地震，震级为里氏7.1级（矩震级7.1），震中位于苗栗，当时属新竹州。这是台湾有记录以来死亡人数最多的地震，造成3276人死亡和大范围破坏。主震发生12秒后，峨眉乡（今新竹县）峨眉村附近又发生一次里氏6.0级余震。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate special election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate special election in Louisiana took place on April 21, 1936, to fill the remainder of the late former Senator Huey Long's six-year term. Long was first elected to the Senate in 1930 and was assassinated on September 10, 1935. Governor Oscar K. Allen won the Democratic primary, but died of a brain hemorrhage one week after the primary win.

zh.s: 1936年路易斯安那州美国参议员特别选举于4月21日举行，以填补已故前参议员休伊·朗六年任期的剩余部分。朗于1930年首次当选参议员，并于1935年9月10日遇刺身亡。州长奥斯卡·K·艾伦赢得民主党初选，但在初选获胜一周后因脑出血去世。

en.t: Establishment of Socialist Unity Party of Germany
en.s: The Socialist Unity Party of Germany (German: Sozialistische Einheitspartei Deutschlands, pronounced [zotsi̯aˈlɪstɪʃə ˈʔaɪnhaɪtspaʁˌtaɪ ˈdɔʏtʃlants] ; SED, pronounced [ˌɛsʔeːˈdeː] ) was the founding and ruling party of the German Democratic Republic (GDR) from the country's establishment in 1949 until the Peaceful Revolution of 1989. Formed in 1946 through a forced merger of the East German branches of the Communist Party of Germany and the Social Democratic Party of Germany, the SED built and ruled East Germany as a one-party Marxist–Leninist state.

zh.s: 德国统一社会党（德语：Sozialistische Einheitspartei Deutschlands，简称SED）是德意志民主共和国（东德）的创建党和执政党，从1949年东德成立执政至1989年和平革命。该党于1946年由德国共产党和德国社会民主党在东德的分支被迫合并而成，并以一党制的马克思列宁主义国家体制建立和统治东德。

en.s: United Nations Security Council Resolution 47, adopted on 21 April 1948, concerns the resolution of the Kashmir conflict. After hearing arguments from both India and Pakistan, the Council increased the size of the UN Commission created by the former Resolution 39 to five members, instructed the Commission to go to the subcontinent and help the governments of India and Pakistan restore peace and order to the region and prepare for a plebiscite to decide the fate of Kashmir.

zh.t: 联合国安理会第47号决议
zh.s: 联合国安理会于1948年4月21日通过第47号决议，讨论解决克什米尔冲突。听取印度和巴基斯坦的陈述后，安理会将此前第39号决议设立的联合国委员会成员增至5人，并指示委员会前往南亚，协助两国政府恢复当地和平与秩序，为决定克什米尔归属的公民投票作准备。

en.s: The Makassar Uprising, also known as Andi Aziz rebellion (Indonesian: Pemberontakan Andi Aziz), was a skirmish in Makassar, Sulawesi, between former Royal Dutch East Indies Army soldiers under Captain Andi Aziz and the Republic of the United States of Indonesia government. The purpose of the uprising was to revolt against the incorporation of the Indonesian federated "states" into the Indonesian Republic.

en.s: The Battle of Chatkol (also known as the 55 Nights of Chatkol) was the name given to the series of skirmishes in early 1953 between United Nations Command (UN) and Chinese People's Volunteer Army (PVA) forces near the village of Chatkol at the centre of the Iron Triangle during the Korean War. The position was held by the Belgian UN contingent for 55 consecutive nights, during which time they came under heavy attack.

en.s: Local elections were held in Taiwan on 21 April 1957, the third nation-wide elections in post-war Taiwan, electing all 21 mayors of cities and magistrates of counties with a three-year tenure. Fuchien Province, then under military administration, was not up for election. Election for Provisional Taiwan Provincial Council was held alongside the local elections to elect 66 councillors.

zh.s: 台湾于1957年4月21日举行地方选举，这是战后台湾第三次全岛范围的选举，改选21个县市的市长和县长，任期三年。当时处于军事管制下的福建省不举行选举。台湾省临时省议会也同时选举66名议员。

en.s: United Air Lines Flight 736 was a scheduled American transcontinental passenger service flown daily by United Airlines between Los Angeles and New York City. On April 21, 1958, the airliner assigned to the flight, a Douglas DC-7 with 47 on board, was flying over Clark County, Nevada in clear weather when it was involved in a daytime mid-air collision with a United States Air Force fighter jet crewed by two pilots.

zh.t: 美国联合航空736号班机空中相撞事故
zh.s: 美国联合航空736号班机是联合航空每天运营的定期跨大陆客运航班，往返洛杉矶和纽约市。1958年4月21日，执行该航班的道格拉斯DC-7客机载有47人，在内华达州克拉克县上空晴朗天气中飞行时，与一架由两名飞行员驾驶的美国空军战斗机在白天发生空中相撞。

en.s: The 1959 Sioux Falls mayoral election took place on April 28, 1959, following a primary election on April 21, 1959. Incumbent Mayor Fay Wheeldon ran for re-election. While former Governor Joe Foss was viewed as a potential candidate, he ultimately declined to run. Wheeldon placed second in the primary election, winning 33 percent of the vote to real estate agent Wendell Hanson's 42 percent.

en.t: Brasília was built in 41 months, and was officially inaugurated in 21 April 1960
en.s: Brasília ( brə-ZIL-ee-ə; Brazilian Portuguese: [bɾaˈziliɐ, bɾaˈziljɐ] ) is the capital city of Brazil and the Federal District. Located in the Brazilian Highlands in the country's Central-West region, it was founded by President Juscelino Kubitschek on 21 April 1960, to replace Rio de Janeiro as the national capital. Brasília is Brazil's third-most populous city after São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, with a population of 2.8 million.

zh.t: 巴西利亚建成并正式启用
zh.s: 巴西利亚（葡萄牙语读音：bɾaˈziliɐ、bɾaˈziljɐ）是巴西首都，也是联邦区所在地。城市位于巴西中西部的巴西高原，由总统儒塞利诺·库比契克创建，于1960年4月21日启用，以取代里约热内卢成为国家首都。巴西利亚是巴西人口第三多的城市，仅次于圣保罗和里约热内卢，人口约280万。

en.t: The Century 21 Exposition, the first world's fair in the United States since World War II, opened in Seattle
en.s: The Century 21 Exposition (also known as the Seattle World's Fair) was a world's fair held April 21, 1962, to October 21, 1962, in Seattle, Washington, United States. Nearly 10 million people attended the fair during its six-month run. As planned, the exposition left behind a fairground and numerous public buildings and public works; some credit it with revitalizing Seattle's economic and cultural life (see History of Seattle (1940–present)).

zh.t: 西雅图世纪21博览会开幕
zh.s: 世纪21博览会又称西雅图世界博览会，于1962年4月21日至10月21日在美国华盛顿州西雅图举行，是二战后美国举办的首届世界博览会。为期六个月的博览会吸引了近1000万人参观。博览会结束后，场地及多座公共建筑和公共设施得以保留；有人认为，它振兴了西雅图的经济和文化生活。

en.s: The 1964 New Jersey Democratic presidential primary was held on April 21, 1964, in New Jersey as one of the Democratic Party's statewide nomination contests ahead of the 1964 United States presidential election. In the binding delegate primary, competing slates of uncommitted delegates contested the election on a ballot The New York Times called "one of the most confusing in the state's recent history."

zh.t: 1964年新泽西州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 1964年新泽西州民主党总统初选于1964年4月21日举行，是民主党为1964年美国总统选举提名候选人而举行的州级竞选活动之一。具有约束力的党代表初选中，各阵营推出尚未承诺支持任何候选人的代表名单。《纽约时报》称这场选举“是该州近代史上最令人困惑的一次”。

en.s: A destructive tornado outbreak affected much of the Midwestern United States on April 21, 1967, in particular the towns of Belvidere and Oak Lawn, Illinois, United States. It was the largest tornado outbreak of 1967 and has been described by NWS Chicago as "Northern Illinois' worst tornado disaster". The outbreak produced numerous and significant (F2+) tornadoes, with ten of them in Illinois alone.

en.s: On the afternoon of April 21, 1967, a violent tornado tracked through Belvidere, Illinois, United States. The tornado struck just after students at the city's high school had been dismissed, as they were loading onto school buses. Many were flipped over and lofted, and the school itself sustained major damage.

zh.s: 1967年4月21日下午，一场强烈龙卷风穿过美国伊利诺伊州贝尔维迪尔。龙卷风袭来时，该市高中刚放学，学生正在上校车。许多校车被掀翻并抛起，学校建筑也严重受损。

en.s: The Apollo Lunar Module (LM ), originally designated the Lunar Excursion Module (LEM), was the lunar lander spacecraft that was flown between lunar orbit and the Moon's surface during the United States' Apollo program. It was the first crewed spacecraft to operate exclusively in space, and remains the only crewed vehicle to land anywhere beyond Earth.
en.n: Astronauts John Young and Charles Duke fly Apollo 16's Apollo Lunar Module to the Moon's surface, the fifth NASA Apollo Program crewed lunar landing.

zh.s: 阿波罗登月舱（LM）最初称为“月球探测舱”（LEM），是在美国阿波罗计划中往返月球轨道与月球表面的登月飞船。它是第一艘仅在太空中运行的载人飞船，也是迄今唯一一款曾在地球以外天体着陆的载人飞行器。

en.s: The Battle of Xuan Loc (Vietnamese: Trận Xuân Lộc) was the last major battle of the Vietnam War in which the Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) committed almost all their remaining mobile forces, especially the South Vietnamese 18th Infantry Division, under General Le Minh Dao to the defence of Xuân Lộc, hoping to stall the advance of the North Vietnamese Army. The battle was fought between April 9 and 21, 1975, and ended when the town of Xuân Lộc was captured by the PAVN 4th Army Corps. This was the ARVN III Corps' last defensive line of South Vietnam's capital, Sài Gòn (Saigon).

zh.s: 春禄战役是越南战争期间南越军队投入几乎所有剩余机动作战部队的最后一场主要战役，其中尤以黎明道将军指挥的南越第18步兵师为主。南越军队试图在春禄阻挡北越军队推进。战斗于1975年4月9日至21日进行，最终北越人民军第4军团攻占春禄。这里是南越首都西贡（今胡志明市）的第三军区最后一道防线。

en.s: Annie is a musical with music by Charles Strouse, lyrics by Martin Charnin, and a book by Thomas Meehan. en.s: The 1985 Sabah state election was held between Saturday, 20 April and Sunday, 21 April 1985. This was the fifth state election to take place. Parti Bersatu Sabah won 25 out 48 seats contested, thus forming government with its president Joseph Pairin Kitingan being sworn in as Chief Minister. This election is a milestone in Sabah political history as it marked the first time that a party not part of the nation's ruling coalition Barisan Nasional (BN) formed government. PBS took control of the state from the previous ruling government under Parti Berjaya—a partner of BN, which has been in power since 1976.

zh.s: 沙巴州于1985年4月20日星期六至21日星期日举行州选举，这是该州第五次选举。沙巴团结党赢得48个席位中的25席，组建政府，其主席约瑟夫·拜林·基廷岸宣誓就任首席部长。这次选举是沙巴政治史上的重要转折：首次由不属于全国执政联盟国阵的政党组建州政府。团结党取代了自1976年执政、属于国阵盟党的进步党。

en.s: The 1986 Prince Edward Island general election was held on April 21, 1986. The election resulted in the defeat of the two-term Progressive Conservative government by the Liberals led by Joe Ghiz. Ghiz, the son of a Lebanese store owner, went on to become the first Canadian premier that was not of complete European descent.

en.s: A snap national general election was held in Italy on 21 April 1996 to elect members of the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate of the Republic. Romano Prodi, leader of the centre-left coalition The Olive Tree, won the election, narrowly defeating Silvio Berlusconi, who led the Pole for Freedoms centre-right coalition. For the election, the Lega Nord of Umberto Bossi ran alone, after having left the Berlusconi I Cabinet in 1994, causing a crisis which drove President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro to appoint a technocratic cabinet led by Lamberto Dini, which in turn lost its Parliamentary support in 1995, forcing Scalfaro to dissolve the Italian Parliament.

zh.s: 意大利于1996年4月21日举行提前大选，选举众议院和共和国参议院议员。中左翼联盟“橄榄树”的领袖罗马诺·普罗迪赢得选举，以微弱优势击败由中右翼自由联盟领袖西尔维奥·贝卢斯科尼。翁贝托·博西领导的北方联盟单独参选，此前该党于1994年退出贝卢斯科尼第一届内阁，引发政治危机。总统奥斯卡·路易吉·斯卡尔法罗任命兰贝托·迪尼领导技术官僚政府，但该政府于1995年失去议会支持，斯卡尔法罗因此解散议会。

en.s: The Jokela rail accident occurred on 21 April 1996, at 07:08 local time (04:08 UTC) in Tuusula, Finland, approximately 50 kilometres (30 mi) north of Helsinki. Four people were killed and 75 injured when express train P82 from Oulu, bound for Helsinki, derailed in heavy fog. The overnight sleeper train was carrying 139 passengers and five crew members. The engine overturned and eight of the twelve carriages derailed. The official investigation into the accident revealed that the accident was due to overspeeding through a slow-speed turnout. It is estimated that the total cost of the accident was over FIM 26 million (€4.3 million).

zh.s: 1996年4月21日当地时间7时08分（UTC 4时08分），约凯拉列车事故发生在芬兰图苏拉，距赫尔辛基以北约50公里（30英里）。从奥卢开往赫尔辛基的P82次特快列车在浓雾中驶过低速道岔时脱轨，造成4人死亡、75人受伤。卧铺列车上有139名乘客和5名乘务员。机车倾覆，12节车厢中有8节脱轨。官方调查认定事故原因是列车通过限速道岔时超速。事故总损失估计超过2600万芬兰马克（430万欧元）。

en.s: The Second Liberian Civil War was a civil war in the West African nation of Liberia that lasted from 1999 to 2003. The war was mainly caused by transition failures after the First Civil War, especially the peace-building process which would result from re-integration, disarmament, rehabilitation and demobilization. President Charles Taylor came to power in 1997 after victory in the First Liberian Civil War which led to two years of peace.

en.s: Backlash (2002) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF) promotion, which took place on April 21, 2002, at Kemper Arena in Kansas City, Missouri. The event starred talent from the Raw and SmackDown! brands. It was the fourth event under the Backlash chronology, the third consecutive Backlash presented by Castrol GTX. This was the first WWF pay-per-view event after the brand extension, and the first to be held at the Kemper Arena since Over the Edge in 1999, in which Owen Hart, competing as The Blue Blazer, lost his life after falling 78 feet from a harness to the ring.

zh.s: 2002年“强烈反弹”是世界摔角联盟（WWF）主办的一场付费职业摔角赛事，于2002年4月21日在密苏里州堪萨斯城的肯珀竞技场举行，参赛者来自Raw和SmackDown!两个品牌。这是“强烈反弹”系列第四场赛事，也是连续第三年由嘉实多GTX赞助。这是品牌扩展后首场WWF付费赛事，也是肯珀竞技场自1999年“越界”赛事以来首次举办此类赛事。那场1999年赛事中，欧文·哈特以“蓝色飞侠”身份参赛，从离地78英尺的吊索坠落至擂台身亡。

en.s: The 2002 French presidential election consisted of a first round election on 21 April 2002, and a runoff election between the top two candidates (Jacques Chirac and Jean-Marie Le Pen) on 5 May 2002. This presidential contest attracted a greater than usual amount of international attention because of far-right candidate Le Pen's unexpected appearance in the runoff election. Chirac ran for a second term, emphasising a strong economy (mostly unaffected by downturns in Germany and the USA). It was widely expected that Chirac and Lionel Jospin, the then prime minister and candidate for the Socialist Party, would be the most popular candidates in the first round, and would thus go on to face each other in the runoff.

zh.s: 2002年法国总统选举首轮投票于4月21日举行，雅克·希拉克和让-马里·勒庞两位得票最高的候选人于5月5日参加决选。极右翼候选人勒庞意外进入决选，引起了比平时更广泛的国际关注。希拉克寻求连任，并强调经济强劲（基本未受德国和美国经济下滑影响）。外界普遍预计，希拉克和当时担任总理的社会党候选人利昂内尔·若斯潘将在首轮得票最多，并于决选对决。

en.s: Municipal elections for 178 municipalities were held in Saudi Arabia between 10 February and 21 April 2005. The first to be held in the country since the 1960s, the elections were held in three stages: the first on 10 February around the capital city of Riyadh, the second in the east and southwest on 3 March, and the third, in the north, on 21 April. Male citizens over the age of 21 voted for half of the members of their municipal councils.

en.s: The Nigerian general elections of 2007 were held on 14 April and 21 April 2007. Governorship and State Assembly elections were held on 14 April, while the Presidential and National Assembly elections were held a week later on 21 April. Umaru Yar'Adua won the highly controversial election for the ruling People's Democratic Party (PDP) and was sworn in on 29 May. Election observers from the European Union described the elections as "the worst they had ever seen anywhere in the world", with "rampant vote rigging, violence, theft of ballot boxes and intimidation."

zh.s: 尼日利亚于2007年4月14日和21日举行大选。州长和州议会选举于4月14日举行，总统和国民议会选举则在一周后的4月21日举行。执政党人民民主党候选人奥马鲁·亚拉杜瓦在争议重重的选举中获胜，并于5月29日宣誓就职。欧盟选举观察员称这是他们“在世界任何地方见过的最糟糕”的选举，存在“普遍的舞弊、暴力、偷走投票箱和恐吓行为”。

en.s: A by-election for the Osaka 12th district in the Japanese House of Representatives was held on 21 April 2019. The by-election was called following the death of the incumbent member Tomokatsu Kitagawa, a member of the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP), from peritonitis on 26 December 2018. en.s: The 2024 Puerto Rico Republican presidential primary was held on April 21, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 23 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a winner-takes-most basis. Former president and presumptive nominee Donald Trump ran unopposed and won all 23 delegates.

zh.t: 2024年波多黎各共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年波多黎各共和党总统初选于2024年4月21日举行，是共和党总统提名初选的一部分。23名代表按“胜者获得大部分代表票”的规则分配给2024年共和党全国代表大会。前总统、当时已确定获得提名的唐纳德·特朗普没有对手，赢得全部23名代表票。

en.s: The 2024 KNVB Cup final was a football match between Eredivisie clubs Feyenoord and NEC Nijmegen, which took place on 21 April 2024 at De Kuip, Rotterdam. It was the final match of the 2023–24 KNVB Cup, the 106th season of the annual Dutch national football cup competition. In history, the two teams had played four matches in the KNVB Cup: the 1994 final, twice in the round of 16 (2000–01 & 2022–23) and once in round two (2012–13).

zh.s: 2024年荷兰杯决赛于2024年4月21日在鹿特丹的德奎普球场举行，由荷甲球队费耶诺德对阵奈梅亨。这是2023—24赛季荷兰杯的最后一场比赛，也是该项荷兰全国杯赛的第106届。两队此前在荷兰杯交手过四次：1994年决赛、2000—01和2022—23赛季的两场十六强赛，以及2012—13赛季第二轮的一场比赛。

en.s: Local elections were held in Poland on 7 April 2024 to elect members for all 16 regional assemblies (sejmik wojewódzki), 314 county (powiat) councils, and 2477 municipal (gmina) councils, heads (wójt) of municipalities and mayors of cities, as well as 18 district councils of Warsaw. While Law and Justice remained the strongest party, the Civic Coalition and its partners saw some improvement, providing them with majorities in up to 11 of the 16 regional assemblies.

zh.s: 波兰于2024年4月7日举行地方选举，选出16个省级议会、314个县议会、2477个市镇议会，以及乡镇首长和市长，并选出华沙的18个区议会。法律与公正党仍是实力最强的政党；公民纲领及其盟友的表现有所提升，在16个省级议会中最多赢得了11个议会的多数席位。

en.s: The 2025 KNVB Cup final was a football match between Eredivisie clubs AZ and Go Ahead Eagles, which took place on 21 April 2025 at De Kuip, Rotterdam, and was won by Go Ahead Eagles. en.s: The Hong Kong International Film Festival (HKIFF) is one of Asia's oldest international film festivals. Founded in 1976, the festival features different movies and filmmakers from different countries, and takes place in Hong Kong. HKIFF screens around 230 films from more than 60 countries in different major cultural venues across the territory every year.

en.s: The 49th Hong Kong International Film Festival (Chinese: 第49屆香港國際電影節) took place from 10 April to 21 April 2025. Louis Koo was selected as the Filmmaker in Focus for this edition and masterclasses led by Albert Serra, Juho Kuosmanen, and Leos Carax were featured. The festival opened with the Japanese crime film The Brightest Sun by Tetsuya Nakashima and the Malaysian-Hong Kong drama Pavane for an Infant by Chong Keat Aun, and closed with the Norwegian drama Dreams (Sex Love) by Dag Johan Haugerud.

zh.t: 第49届香港国际电影节闭幕
zh.s: 第49届香港国际电影节于2025年4月10日至21日举行，焦点影人是古天乐，并举办了阿尔伯特·塞拉、尤霍·库奥斯曼恩和莱奥·卡拉克斯的电影大师班。电影节以中岛哲也执导的日本犯罪片《恶之地》及庄凯勋执导的马来西亚与香港合拍片《摇篮凡世》开幕，并以达格·约翰·豪格鲁德执导的挪威剧情片《梦想》（《性、爱》）闭幕。
